page.overview:
What is The Shadow Rising?

left|thumb|200pxThe Shadow Rising (abbreviated tSR) is the fourth book in The Wheel of Time series. It was published by Tor Books and released on September 15, 1992. It is 1004 pages long. {| cellspacing="0" cellpadding="5px" style="border:none;"

At the beginning of this book, all major protagonists are together at the Stone of Tear, where Rand al'Thor had recently shown to the world that he was the Dragon Reborn by wielding Callandor.

Faced with the tension of sharing Rand with others, as well as coming to understand their similar stubbornness and devotion towards him, Egwene al'Vere "steps aside", formally inviting her close friend and Daughter-Heir of Andor, Elayne Trakand, to take Rand as her own. Elayne, overjoyed by her friend's sacrifice, allows Egwene to declare the end of her assumed betrothal to Rand before admitting her love for him and starting a romantic relationship.

Later, Rand’s previous traveling companion, Selene, appears to him and reveals herself to be Lanfear, one of the Forsaken. She tries to persuade him to join her and the forces of the Shadow, even stating her willingness to defy the Dark One if only he would be with her. As Rand furiously rejects her, the Stone of Tear is suddenly stormed by two opposing groups of Trollocs and Myrddraal, later learned to be sent by other Forsaken, Sammael and Semirhage. Rand uses Callandor to kill all of the Shadowspawn with lightning, leaving some believing Rand has already gone mad.
